sloka: सुप्रीत मनसः सर्वे प्रत्यूचुः मुदिता भृशम् ।ततः प्रसर्पकेभ्यस्तु हिरण्यम् सुसमाहितः ॥१-१४-५३॥
transliteration: suprīta manasaḥ sarve pratyūcuḥ muditā bhṛśam ।tataḥ prasarpakebhyastu hiraṇyam susamāhitaḥ ॥1-14-53॥

translations.english: When the brahmins were pleased, king Dasaratha who was fond of brahmins bowed to them with his eyes filled with delight.
